corrections: In daily use the rename case is close to unreachable. The debounce fires 300 ms after the last edit whether or not the canvas has focus, and any rename the user starts (dialog, file tree, F2) takes longer than that, so pendingPersist is already false when the re-key destroys the instance. Only a programmatic rename (auto-move, which is off by default, or a watcher-detected rename) can hit it, so demote the rename criterion. Option 2 ('save a path with no open tab straight to disk') is unsafe for rename: it would write to the old path and recreate the renamed-away file. Prefer the pre-close flush hook. 'Stale in the text below: Accurate at HEAD' is wrong for the merged Issue 49 section: EditorView is now keyed (:83-85), persists already go by path (onContentChangeForPath), and its line numbers (EditorView:80-81, CanvasInner:85-115/:208-234, editor.service.ts:228-231/:266-294) are stale.
